newsitem.title: DUBAI: Population in Saudi capital seen at 9 mln in 2020.
newsitem.headline: Population in Saudi capital seen at 9 mln in 2020.

text.p: The population of Saudi Arabia's capital Riyadh is growing at a rate of eight percent a year and is expected to reach nine million by 2020, said a study carried by a Saudi newspaper on Thursday.
Estimates by the centre for projects and planning at the higher board for the development of Riyadh said the capital currently had more than three million inhabitants, the daily Okaz newspaper said.
The centre said 50 percent of the capital's current inhabitants were under the age of 25, the paper added.
